turns.learner: Hello! I need English for daily life here. Can we practise and, but and because?

planner.explanation: Task-based because B1 or above, partly secure or better, with a real-life goal; main method Formative Assessment & Feedback Loops because: Do the task, then feedback on one or two language errors.

turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes, we can. Our goal today: join two short sentences into one, using and, but or because.

Imagine you are telling a colleague about your day. Short separate sentences sound choppy. One joined sentence sounds clearer.

One quick question to start: write one short sentence about something you did today. Then we will work on joining ideas.
